remarks: ** Highest and best by Tuesday at 5pm** Welcome to this spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath condominium at 97 Richards Avenue #G10, offering a perfect blend of comfort and convenience in the heart of West Norwalk. With 1,196 square feet of open-concept living, this home boasts generously sized rooms that create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The living room flows effortlessly into the dining area and kitchen, making it ideal for entertaining or simply relaxing at home. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet and a private en-suite bath, while the second bedroom is perfect for guests or a home office. Step outside onto the large deck to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a long day, with a tranquil view of the outdoors. The unit also comes equipped with in-unit laundry for your convenience. This well-maintained complex includes a sparkling in-ground pool and scenic walking trails. Situated just minutes from Connecticut Avenue's many shops and restaurants, and with easy access to Darien's train station and amenities, this location offers unparalleled convenience. The unit is perfectly positioned at the front of the complex, providing easy access in and out, and comes with two reserved parking spaces. Don't miss the opportunity to explore this beautiful condominium in one of Norwalk's most sought-after communities!
